title: --explain / explain flag on analysis tools
description:
Sutra returns scored/ranked outputs (importance in `sutra_map`, blast radius in `sutra_impact`, co-change strength in `sutra_cochange`, FTS fuzzy match in `sutra_find`) but the scores arrive opaque. Add an `explain` flag that expands the scoring rationale.

Agents need this most — they're the primary consumers and have to reason about whether a result is trustworthy without a human to eyeball it. So MCP-first. CLI second, because humans still want to inspect why sutra ranked file X above Y when triaging.

Concrete shapes per tool:
- `sutra_map` → why this file scored high (fan_in, importance contributors, parse status)
- `sutra_impact` → BFS frontier visible (which symbols at depth 1, 2, 3), risk-level reasoning
- `sutra_find` → why FTS chose this match over others (exact vs stemmed vs fuzzy)
- `sutra_cochange` → commit count, time window, Jaccard or whichever metric

qi reference: `qi query --explain` for the surface inspiration. The substance is sutra-specific.

acceptance_criteria.text: MCP: explain flag on sutra_map, sutra_impact, sutra_find, sutra_cochange
Each explain payload is structured (not just a debug string)
CLI: --explain flag mirrors the MCP surface for human inspection
